ui.agents.refusals.name_taken: An agent called “{name}” already exists. Choose another name, or open the existing one to change it.
ui.agents.refusals.name_grammar: Names cannot contain spaces or slashes.
ui.agents.refusals.effort_unavailable: “{tier}” is not a configured effort tier. Use inherit, or add the tier in Settings.
ui.agents.refusals.missing_manager: “{name}” is not an agent or a team on this machine.
ui.agents.refusals.missing_member: “{name}” is not an agent or a team on this machine.
ui.agents.refusals.team_nesting: That team would nest too deeply, or would contain itself. Check its members.
ui.agents.refusals.class.meaning.proacti: It may message you on its own: after sending you something it waits a few minutes for a reply, nudges again with growing gaps for a fixed number of tries, then waits for you — and it may also wake on its own schedule.
ui.agents.refusals.class.meaning.reactiv: It replies when you write to it. It does not nudge you, and it does not wake on its own schedule.
ui.agents.refusals.class.effect.proactiv: Turning this off stops the nudging and the scheduled wakes. It still replies when you write to it.
ui.agents.refusals.class.effect.reactive: Turning this on lets it write first: it will wait a few minutes for your reply, nudge you again up to a fixed number of tries, and it may wake on its own schedule. It still replies when you write to it.
ui.agents.refusals.class.install_disclos: This one ships with the app and has no copy of its own yet, so switching installs it first — the same agent and the same instructions, now editable — and then sets its class.
ui.agents.refusals.class.error.no_reason: The backend sent no reason for it. Try the switch again.
ui.agents.refusals.class.error.install_l: {reason} The install did land, so the agent is editable now.
